entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  Bollinger position = -18% of band -> +100 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  RSI 1h = 22.0 -> +35 (weight 2.0) - Oversold - better risk/reward than chasing
  support proximity = 0.46% away -> +40 (weight 1.4) - Support 2,546.72 (2 touches) - better risk/reward, conditional on it holding
  RSI divergence (1d) = hidden bullish -> +35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  range position = lower part of the range -> +30 (weight 1.2) - Buying the lower half of a range is a better entry than the top
  distance to EMA20 = -3.33% -> +20 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,558.52 vs EMA20 2,646.74
  resistance proximity = 19.4% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI daily = 44.0 -> +13 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (11.1) = +36.4 -> FAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.
